changed.english: Check GitHub for new versions of PadForge and install them from here, and update the controller database. PadForge contacts only GitHub (api.github.com, github.com and its download servers, and raw.githubusercontent.com for the controller database), and the address you set under the Controller Database row’s Download From. The only data it sends is its own version number and, for the controller database, the tag the server gave the last download.
changed.where: Settings, General, Updates card: the card's description, its tooltip and search words

changed.english: Update Now downloads the community controller database (SDL_GameControllerDB) from GitHub, or from the address set under More, and keeps, in the settings file, the mappings this version of PadForge lacks. They are in use at once. From another address it keeps new mappings only. A new mapping is used only for a controller that nothing else reads as a gamepad, that is not assigned and that is not in Force Raw Joystick Mode. The reset removes every downloaded mapping and downloads from GitHub again. Your own rows, under More, stay.
